name: Seanime
description: Seanime is an open-source media server and anime management application. This container provides the Seanime server and web interface with FFmpeg support. Application data is stored in /config and the anime library is mounted at /anime.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent Seanime configuration, database, cache, and application data.

variables.name: Server Host
variables.description: Seanime server bind address. Leave this as 0.0.0.0 when running in Docker.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID used to run Seanime. The default of 99 matches the Unraid 'nobody' user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID used to run Seanime. The default of 100 matches the Unraid 'users' group.
